title: Stone Alpine Ski Chalet Overlooking Snowy Valley, c. 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A high-altitude black-and-white snapshot taken from the edge of a ski slope, showing the tips of a skier's skis in the lower left foreground. A rustic stone mountain chalet with a wooden railed balcony and stone chimney perches on the steep hillside overlooking an expansive, snow-dusted valley and distant rolling mountain ridges beneath a brooding, overcast alpine sky.
